title: Cross-frequency ear-rank reversals did not establish added tinnitus prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: High-frequency interaural rank-crossing burden did not establish incremental past-year tinnitus prediction across separately sampled NHANES2001–2002 and2003–2004 adults: weighted Brier gain 0.0003677,400 source+target PSU-refit95%interval[-0.0036595,0.0019691]. Source CV gain was negative. This does not establish equivalence or absence of physiological information.
